_meta.notes:
Single uniform platform for all 31 districts. PDF bodies linked from one non-paginated HTML page per senator. Listing format:

YEAR

followed by sibling

blocks each holding date + icon + to PDF or videoplayer.php. Date format MM/DD/YYYY. No JS, no Akamai, robots.txt permissive. Offices upload press PDFs in backdated batches — the listing date is the release date, not the upload date, and the lag runs to four months (verified 2026-07-25 via Last-Modified headers). The collector therefore re-sweeps the whole 2025-01-01+ window every run instead of trusting the incremental cutoff. pressroom.php?d=N 302-redirects to members.php when a district has no sitting member; the collector flags that rather than reading it as an empty pressroom. D4 filled by Brett Ligon (sworn 2026-05-19). D22 vacant since Birdwell resigned 2026-05-26. Eight districts publish nothing recent to senate.texas.gov; their last-published dates are recorded per member below.
